content.body:
Hitting (enter) key will bring up the chat tool in "area" mode. This allows you to chat with players nearby (within 40 meters). To type a private message to johndoe, use the .m command like this: ".m johndoe hi johndoe! can you show me how to..." Private messages go any distance, anywhere in the entire theatre of battle.
Be careful, if there are enemies nearby they may detect your open chat conversations. You may see enemy conversations as "garbled chat" when they are near you.
